- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/[pmcoa|pubmed].cgi/[BioC_JSON|BioC_XML]/[PMIDs|PMCIDs]/[UNICODE|ASCII]
    Functions: Extracting pubmed abstracts or PMC full texts in BioC format.
     - [pmcoa]: PMC full texts (open access subset)
     - [pubmed]: PubMed abstracts
     - [UNICODE]: Output in unicode
     - [ASCII]: Output in ascii
    Examples:
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/pubmed.cgi/bioc_json/17299597,17299598/ascii
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/pmcoa.cgi/BioC_xml/17299597,17299598/unicode
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/pmcoa.cgi/bioc_json/PMC1790863,PMC1790864/unicode

     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat.cgi/[BioC_JSON|BioC_XML]/[PMIDs|PMCIDs]/[# of SM|LIST]
    Functions: Extracting PMC open access supplementary material (SM) in BioC format.
     - [# of SM]: The # of SM files of the article. It can be reached from # by LIST option.
     - [LIST]: Lists all supplementary filenames of the requested articles.
    Examples:
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat.cgi/bioc_xml/PMC7294781/1
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat.cgi/bioc_xml/PMC7294781/all
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat.cgi/bioc_xml/PMC7294781/list

- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_relevant.cgi/[BioC_JSON|BioC_XML]/[PMIDs|PMCIDs]/SM-filename
    Functions:
     - supplmat_relevant: Extracting relevant SM files searched by a specific SM file (a combination of PMCID+filename).
    Examples:
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_relevant.cgi/bioc_xml/PMC7641839/13058_2020_1355_MOESM5_ESM.docx

- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_query_request.cgi/[BioC_JSON|BioC_XML]/[PMIDs|PMCIDs]/[Code]
    Functions:
     - supplmat_query_request: Submit a request to extract relevant SM files by a query.
     - [Code]: Please assign a data type to the search. The avaliable codes are shown in below table.
    Examples:
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_query_request.cgi/bioc_xml/breast cancer/GPED


- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_query_receive.cgi/[Accession number]
    Functions:
     - supplmat_query_receive Number: Retrieve the relevant SM files.
     - [Accession number]: The accession number assigned by supplmat_query_request.cgi
    Examples:
     - https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/bionlp/RESTful/supplmat_query_receive.cgi/bioc_xml/breast cancer/GPED
